description: List the user's Resy reservations. Defaults to upcoming; pass scope="past" or "all" to broaden. Each result includes the resy_token needed for cancellation, plus occasion/special_request/cancellability.

view.description: "full" (default) returns each reservation as JSON; "brief" returns one line per reservation: <venue> <HH:MM>, party of <n> — <YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM or "no date"> — <booked|past>, inside the untrusted-data envelope as data: string[] (venue names are third-party text); "-- none" when there are none.

name: resy_list_reservations
